summary.text: Oyo’s cavalry invaded Dahomey in 1726, defeated King Agaja and burned Abomey, then came back in 1728, 1729 and 1730 until Agaja agreed to pay a yearly tribute. When Tegbesu haggled over it, Oyo invaded again in 1748 and forced a higher tribute, which Dahomey paid until 1823.

moments.title: Abomey burned
moments.text: The first invasion defeats Agaja’s army and burns his capital.

moments.title: Tribute agreed
moments.text: After invasions in 1728, 1729 and 1730, Agaja agrees to a yearly tribute of people, guns, cloth and cowries.

moments.title: A higher tribute
moments.text: Oyo invades again and Tegbesu flees, then agrees a higher tribute. It is paid until 1823.
